VAPOR-CONE CRACK — camera locked at matched altitude directly ahead as the skyship accelerates into transonic range, the vapor-cone forming a perfect translucent dome around its blade-hull's widest point, pressure-distortion warping the landscape visible through the cone's lens-effect, the cone collapsing in a ring-shockwave that hits the lens, blurring the frame for one violent frame before clarity returns.

AURORA-PIERCE CLIMB — camera below and behind as the skyship climbs vertically through an aurora-curtain, blade-wings shearing the luminous green veil into spiraling fragments, the aurora re-sealing behind its tail-fin, the ship's silhouette shrinking against the celestial light-wall as altitude increases, stars appearing above the aurora's upper boundary, the ground lost in darkness ten kilometers below.

COCKPIT-CANOPY PURSUIT — camera behind scratched forward canopy glass as a fleeing skyship banks hard left into a storm-wall, the target's blade-hull silhouetted against white lightning, amber reticle drifting to track, rain hammering the canopy in white streaks, instrument-glow painting the glass amber and red, the target's contrail whipping sideways as it pushes into the storm's embrace.

CHASE-CAM SECOND-SHIP — camera mounted on the pursuing skyship's prow as the lead blade-hull cuts a corkscrew path through a broken cloud-layer, the target's twin contrails spiraling into a double-helix fifty meters ahead, both hulls banking together through thirty degrees, the cloud-tops scrolling past at terrifying velocity, the pursuing ship's blade-wing edge cutting into frame-left as it mirrors the turn.

MATCHED-VELOCITY PARALLEL — camera locked at identical speed beside the skyship's starboard flank, the blade-hull filling the entire left half of frame in riveted black iron, horizon tilting twenty-five degrees in a sustained bank, cloud-deck scrolling beneath at wave-crest speed, the ship's prow vanishing to a vanishing-point ahead while the tail-fin disappears behind, scale confirmed by a lone crow frozen mid-air by relative velocity.

CORKSCREW PURSUIT — camera spiraling behind the skyship as it executes a tight corkscrew climb, the blade-hull rotating through three hundred sixty degrees across the frame's center while the horizon pinwheels around it, contrail describing a perfect screw-thread into the upper cloud-layer, the ship's belly and dorsal surfaces alternating exposure, altitude markers spinning at the frame's lower corner.

GOD'S-EYE HIGH-ALTITUDE — camera positioned at extreme altitude looking directly down as the skyship threads between two cloud-formations, its blade-silhouette sharp and black against white overcast five kilometers below, shadow visible as a tiny cross on a patchwork of fields eight kilometers further below that, contrails marking its recent path in a long arc curving from the horizon.

SATELLITE OVERHEAD-PASS — camera at near-orbital distance looking straight down as the skyship's blade-form crosses a coastline, its shadow falling across three kilometers of cliff-face and open sea simultaneously, contrail a white pen-stroke across the blue, the megacity beyond the cliffs rendering the ship's silhouette the size of a needle against its sprawl, curvature of the horizon visible at frame-edge.

SPIRE-ROOFTOP DOWN-ANGLE — camera perched on the needle-tip of an iron spire looking down as the skyship passes three hundred meters below at matched elevation, its blade-hull foreshortened to a cross-shape from directly above, rooftop crowds visible as specks scattering in the downwash, the ship's contrail already a fading white crease curving away toward the distant ridge-line.

MOUNTAIN-SUMMIT BELOW — camera at snow-line on a summit looking down the leeward face as the skyship threads the valley between two ridges far below, its blade-form tiny against the valley's scale until contrail-width proves otherwise, snow dislodged from the summit by its pressure-wave tumbling past the lens in slow arcs, the ship banking into the valley's curve and disappearing behind a buttress.

MOUNTAIN-PASS THREAD — camera locked in the choke-point between granite walls as the skyship banks forty degrees to fit blade-wings between cliff-faces, rock surfaces close enough to read individual fracture-lines, contrails ricocheting off the pass walls in expanding rings, the ship's hull-tip grazing loose scree from the right face, altitude-numerals spinning in the frame-corner, the sky-slot beyond the pass blazing white.

URBAN-CANYON THREAD — camera positioned at street level in a megacity's vertical canyon as the skyship descends to building-gap altitude, blade-wings clearing tower-facades by single-digit meters, windows shattering in sequential percussion down both walls, the ship's exhaust-cone painting the lower floors in wavering violet light, the vanishing-point of the street-canyon pulling its silhouette to a razor-point ahead.

SEA-STACK THREADING — camera hovering at sea-stack crown-height as the skyship slices between three isolated pinnacles, blade-wings angled sixty degrees in a knife-edge pass, sea-spray from the stacks' bases climbing into the frame, the ocean's surface a hammered-lead sheet seventy meters below, the ship's contrail bouncing between pinnacle walls in twin spirals before dissipating into salt air.

MEGACITY LOW-PASS — camera mounted at rooftop-garden level as the skyship makes a flat low-pass at cornice-height, blade-hull twenty meters above the street-grid, downwash stripping market canopies from their struts and flinging them end-over-end, the ship's shadow racing across one hundred city-blocks in three seconds, residents pressed flat on observation decks, contrail unspooling through the avenue-grid below tower-crowns.
